summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (`_0xNNNN` identifiers, string-array lookups) and, on `npm install`, downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a sibling `math_init.js` — a 727KB obfuscated blob (rotating string-array via `WV8StW(...)` over a large numeric/token table, hex-mangled identifiers, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). Executing the payload under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bypasses Node-based scanners and IDE tooling that inspect Node module loads. The delivery mechanism, opaque payload, and use of a second language runtime are unrelated to the package's advertised ESLint configuration purpose and mismatch the visible eslint-config surface (index.js, plugins/). The `@ornikar` scope suggests targeting of downstream consumers of the Ornikar organization's ESLint configs via scope/account compromise or lookalike publication.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
